user_preferences.language: English for all text, Chinese+English for talent/spell names
user_preferences.terminology: Use '鸟德' not '鸡德' for Balance Druid

typical_costs.analyze_player_log: ~5-7 points + benchmark cost if not cached

rate_limit.advice: Benchmarks cache for 6 hours. First query per spec/boss is expensive, subsequent ones are free. Budget ~300 points per coaching session.

coaching_tips.workflow: 1) get_coaching_context first, 2) get_encounters to find boss IDs, 3) benchmarks (builds/rotation/timelines), 4) analyze_player_log for coaching
coaching_tips.rotation_notes: get_rotation_profile samples only 5 players — treat as directional, not definitive. Spell IDs can differ between reports for same ability.
coaching_tips.timeline_notes: get_cooldown_timelines uses sample_size=50 default. Use 20-25 to conserve rate limit for casual coaching.
coaching_tips.analysis_notes: analyze_player_log auto-detects encounter_id from the report. Benchmarks are fetched in parallel and cached.
known_limitations: Spell name resolution relies on masterData.abilities per-report — some proc effects may show as IDs
Build comparison uses WCL talent entry IDs — ~93.6% coverage, 6.4% are dead talents
Boss phases config is static/approximate — not derived from actual log phase transitions
Buff uptimes include all buffs on the player (including externals from healers)
